'''''Spirit of Solaris''''', originally named '''''Pride of Aridus''''', was an infiltration ship of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nord (Rebel)|Nord]].

==History==
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the ''Pride of Aridus'' dropped off a Rebel commando team on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified planet (Alliance Special Ops operation)|world]]. When the team came back late and under heavy fire, second-mate [[Alfonso Luiz Obota]] mutinied against Nord, who wished to leave the team behind. Five of the ''Aridus''{{'}} crewmen and all but three commandos were killed in the rescue attempt. Obota was court-martialed and imprisoned as a result. Later, the ship was renamed ''Spirit of Solaris''.<ref name="DF: JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>
